source.scope: Recipe-generator dependency graph and both structural/stratified auditors

checks: Finite quantities, all ingredient references, exact allergen union and dietary exclusions
Cooking endpoint, thermometer and safety-source presence
One regional finish after the main and seeded preparation before finish
Regional marker leakage outside explicitly selected side
Main-portion outliers, whole-bird quantities and rest
Individual step versus total cooking window
Every cooking row: one-versus-twelve serving ingredient quantities, with discrete whole-bird counts
Fifty live witnesses: exact share rebuild identity, ingredients, quantities and cooking method
Smoked meat: one rest stage, no rest during cooking, rest duration agrees with recorded timing
limits: Content and arithmetic checks cannot establish taste, successful kitchen execution, actual doneness or packet contents.
Every default/chosen-cut cooking row receives the requested number of distinct rotating inputs; this is not fifty repetitions of every full Cartesian combination.
Regional side choices are explicit fusion inputs and do not count as accidental main-seasoning leakage.
A source change invalidates the run; rerun against the final frozen culinary source.
